task: I need to get my handmade jewelry and craft items online quickly. I'll set up my Ecwid store, add a few unique products with details and photos, organize them into categories, and then customize my store's look to match my brand. Finally, I'll try to update some product details in bulk or reorganize my categories to see how flexible it is.

observations.what: Registration itself was quick (name, email, password; Cloudflare Turnstile passed automatically; the '+' email alias was accepted; no email verification needed before entering the control panel).
There is no free plan: immediately after registering, the control panel shows 'Find the right plan for you' with only paid tiers (Starter $5/mo, Venture $29/mo, Business $49/mo, Unlimited $119/mo).
Every control-panel route I tried (#products, #product:mode=new) redirected back to #select-plan, so products, categories and design settings were unreachable without picking a plan.
Clicking Get Started on the cheapest Starter plan opened a 'pay-during-signup' billing page asking for payment, so there is no card-free trial path; I stopped there per the no-payment rule.
My first click on 'Next: Set up your Store' missed because the password-strength hints appeared and pushed the button down about 120px.
